title: Fusion Power (EPSRC CDT)
about: Doctoral programme at the University of Oxford's EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Fusion Power, starting 4 October 2027. The deadline for 2027-28 entry and Oxford scholarship consideration is midday UK time, 6 January 2027.
